text: 记者从多家银行理财公司了解到，在此前一轮试点基础上，新一轮养老理财产品的扩围有望很快落地。“我们已经报了材料，后续看审批情况。”一家头部银行理财子业务部门负责人对记者表示。据记者汇总了解，满足监管条件的机构最早有望于9月底获批发行新一批养老理财产品，部分机构已开始准备产品发行相关事宜。进入准备阶段的机构，包括已发行过养老理财产品的公司，也包括从未发行相关产品的公司。中国理财网数据显示，截至目前共10家理财公司发行 51只养老理财产品。（财联社）
text_en: Reporters learned from multiple bank wealth management companies that, building on the previous pilot round, the expansion of a new batch of pension wealth management products is expected to land soon. “We have submitted materials, and the rest depends on the review outcome,” a business department head at a leading bank wealth management subsidiary told reporters. According to aggregated reporting, institutions meeting regulatory conditions are expected to receive approval to issue a new batch of pension wealth management products as early as end-September, with some already preparing for product issuance. Institutions in the preparation stage include both those that have issued such products before and those that have never done so. Data from China Wealth Management Network shows that, to date, 10 wealth management companies have issued 51 pension wealth management products. (CLS)
